notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
Version 1.08

- Fixed a bug where the audio was not saved in the options screen
- Fixed a bug where the cancel button of options screen was not working
- Fixed a bug where the audio of "Chaos Message" in chaos mode was not stop playing when game is paused

notes.title: Game Update ! - Patch 1.06
notes.content:
Patch 1.06 is released !

- Minor bug fixes
- Performance improvment

Patch 1.05

notes.title: Game Update - Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Patch 1.02

- Added option to disable light effects on explosions
- Added option to disable effects when shots hit walls
- Changed "Dead Zone" for Gamepad Analog Controls
- Other minor bugs fixed

notes.title: Game Update - Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Patch 1.01 - Minor update

After feedback from some players, we made the following updates:

- Modified crosshair image for better viewing.
- Added option to disable the background and have a better viewing (bye bye matrix effect :( )
- Halved the effects of lights. If you already have the game installed it is recommended to go to the options menu and adjust the lights in a way that is pleasing to your eyes.


Thanks to everyone who bought our game. Continue send your feedback to further improve ShapeNeon Chaos!

notes.title: Beta Update 7 - Joystick support !
notes.content:
In this beta update we added Joystick support ! 
Now you can play the game and navigate in the game menus with a Gamepad. Also can play in "Big Picture".
Hope you enjoy it !

notes.title: Beta Update 2 - Time Attack mode
notes.content:
Today in Beta update, we added a new play mode: "Time Attack"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/18b2a314450cf9bfdfa97edfcd39866988e3f1a4.png

Start with just 1 life and 1 bomb (you can gain more each 2:30 minutes)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/163d894975148b2e3c5d59eff8beb45654a26b70.png

In this mode there is no score, you have to survive as long as you can

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/5aadf4db7114e10de766e636bc481cde3a505a5b.png

In this mode there is no high score, you have to beat the best time

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39567146/7b4607727446afd5bf55fda075092dfb9f4e53a2.png


Add the game to your WishList to get ready to launch !
